## Checklist

- [ ] One bounded context or app changed (or a contract-only PR)
- [ ] `make check` is green
- [ ] Tests cover the change, including failure paths
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or logging of message text
- [ ] Migrations are backward compatible and non-destructive
- [ ] Contracts / ADRs / module README updated if behaviour changed
